newsitem.title: USA: Drilex sees Q4 EPS not much better than Q3.
newsitem.headline: Drilex sees Q4 EPS not much better than Q3.

text.p: Drilex International Inc said Monday its fourth quarter earnings are unlikely to be appreciably better than the $0.19 per share reported for the third quarter.
Wall Street expects fourth quarter earnings of $0.26 per share, according to a First Call consensus estimate.
Drilex, which provides drilling products for oil and gas wells, blamed late-arriving equipment from Venezuela and less-than-expected revenues from directional drilling jobs in the Austin Chalk.
The company reported net income of nearly $1.3 million in the third quarter.
"Fourth quarter earnings could be approximately $200,000 lower than the third quarter results if an expected product sale is not shipped during the fourth quarter," the company said.
